overal.goal: Close the remaining gaps for restricted keys found by the group 3 security review (2026-10-29): webhooks.create sets projects to every project without capping them to the caller's projects, and webhooks.delete removes any webhook — apply the same reach check as client management; PUT /settings accepts review-trust and project-limited keys — refuse or limit it for restricted principals; a review client can set a human's archived plan back to draft — extend the ownership check beyond active plans; rotating or revoking a hidden client answers 403 with details naming its scopes and projects, while an unknown id answers 404 — answer hidden clients like unknown ones.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Raised by the group 3 security review on 2026-10-29; not started.

tests.strategy: Security tests per gap with a restricted key, over REST v1, the unversioned /api routes and MCP where exposed.
